refusal_text_boundary.fact: No text raised through fail() (src/terrain.mjs) is a line of ANY owner surface this artifact grammars. fail() writes to stderr and exits.
refusal_text_boundary.scope: global — it holds for every surface here, covered or uncovered, and each surface restates it rather than inheriting it silently
refusal_text_boundary.stated_by_mechanism_not_enumeration: The boundary names the FUNCTION, not a list of messages. A list goes stale on the next fail() added and leaves message N+1 uncovered by default — the shape §14.1 and §9 both chose against.
refusal_text_boundary.reopen_trigger: the first owner-facing refusal text written to stdout, or into the report file, rather than raised through fail() — that one is on a surface and owes a line class

line_classes.form: judged by <model_id> / <effort_tier> — OBSERVED:… | judge pin DECLARED — <model_id> / <effort_tier>.…
line_classes.governing: SPEC-terrain §6.2, §12.1 — and kogaki#892, which is what put TWO alternatives here. The first is emitted where the Harness observed the judgment act itself; the second where it did not, which is every run today because Terrain invokes no judge. Both are composed by one function (`judgePinLine`), so this class and the report's `judge` class cannot come to say different things about one record. WRAPPED at the display column since kogaki#919, so the form abbreviates immediately after the pin: the first rendered line is a prefix of the sentence and its continuations are the `judge_pin_continuation` class below. Abbreviating right after the placeholders rather than mid-clause is deliberate — a longer model id moves the wrap point, and a form pinning literal text past it would refuse exactly the ids it did not anticipate. AND THE ABBREVIATION STOPS AT THE PIN CLAUSE'S LAST CHARACTER, NOT ONE SPACE LATER (PR #921 round 1 finding 1): the first cut read `<effort_tier>. …`, whose compiled prefix demanded the space AFTER the period and therefore a further word on the first rendered line — so a model id past roughly 45 characters wrapped before it, no class matched, and `emitOrRefuse` refused the whole cotag_groups surface. The emitter now carries the pin clause as an UNBREAKABLE HEAD, so what this form pins is text no input can move off line 1; the two halves are one repair and neither works alone.
line_classes.superseded: judged by <model_id> / <effort_tier> (§6.2 — a judged surface with no judge pin is the drift-undetectable shape) (kogaki#892: the line asserted a judgment the Harness never observed. It was emitted on the strength of the subdivisions record's own `judged: true` and its declared pin — a declaration rendered as an observation, which is the right act with a guard silently disabled.) (kogaki#919: the line was emitted as one unwrapped string of roughly 450 characters, on the surface kogaki#317 exists to keep readable under wrapping, while its report counterpart `judged_empty_notice_declared` was hand-wrapped at the same content.)

line_classes.governing: SPEC-terrain §12.1 — the identity's third component, rendered WITH what the Harness observed of it (kogaki#892) and with the pin's own identity respected (kogaki#918). THREE alternatives, composed by one function (`reportJudgeLine`) so this class and the display's `judge_pin` class cannot come to say different things about one record. The first is emitted against the typed literal `none`, which is the ABSENCE of a pin and so declares nothing; the second where a pin was declared and the Harness observed no invocation, which is every run today; the third where it observed one. Every arm names what the RECORD holds, never what the run passed — the idempotent-rerun path re-renders a prior record through this same composer.

limits._why: OWNER-EDITABLE NUMBERS, in the carrier the grammar already lives in (kogaki#738 ruling 5, extended by owner amendment 2 of 2026-09-01). A second config file would be a second place for a number to drift from the surface that renders it, so no new carrier is minted: the runtime reads these exactly as it reads decidable_rules.subdivision_required_at_ten.threshold_members. THE HARNESS ENFORCES EVERY KEY MECHANICALLY — amendment 2 ruling 2's own words, 'refusals, never reliance on the LLM following them implicitly' — so a key declared here with no refusal reading it is a defect rather than a default.

subgroup_member_cap._why_asymmetric: Brief consumes a `tight` group WHOLE and cannot yet filter Strands, so an oversized tight group lands entirely in a consumer with no way to narrow it — the harder cap follows the consumer's inability rather than the label's seniority. `related` and `loose` are browse material a reader scans and selects from.
subgroup_member_cap._residual_is_not_here: `other` is NOT an affinity label and carries no entry in this map. It is the RESIDUAL, bounded by `max_residual_members` below — a different quantity with a different purpose, and giving it a row here would let a reader treat the residual as a fourth affinity.

limits._why_thesis_candidates: How many Thesis candidates the Full Report's §12.3 section carries (kogaki#760, owner ruling 2026-09-01 that this is configurable like the member caps). ENFORCED MECHANICALLY at the runtime, per this block's own `_why`: a supplied candidate list whose length is not this number REFUSES the render, naming both figures. It is not a maximum and not a default the emitter pads toward — the count is exact, because a section whose length varies run to run cannot be read as a fixed early image.
limits._why_min: A composed SubGroup under M is refused (amendment 1 ruling 3, M initial 3). TWO EXEMPTIONS, both stated rather than left to the code: the residual has no floor, because a residual shrinking toward zero is the outcome the whole design wants and a floor would refuse exactly the classifications that did best; and a SubGroup holding the WHOLE parent group is exempt (owner selection 2026-09-01), because M refuses a splinter and a SubGroup that divided nothing produced none. Without the second, a group under M has no conformant affinity classification at all and the residual becomes its only path, which would force the judge to assert an absence of affinity that may be false.
limits._why_residual_cap: `other` = unlimited is an ANTI-PATTERN (owner amendment 1, superseding the body's '`other` is unbounded'). Until the residual falls to N the harness refuses the classification and forces the creation of additional SubGroups, naming the remainder count against N. This is the share cap's replacement: the deleted `catch_all_share` bounded a bucket the ENGINE filled as a fraction of its parent; this bounds a bucket the JUDGE fills as an absolute count, which is what stops Lessons disappearing into a black-box residual.

expressible.rule: zero `lesson:` tokens and zero element names on an owner surface
every token in a member-list position matches tokens.LessonDisplayID
a line whose class is not in the surface's line_classes ⇒ REFUSE
every Group heading carries a GroupID matching tokens.GroupID, and every SubGroup heading a SubGroupID matching tokens.SubGroupID
sum of LessonCount over a group's `subgroup_heading` lines == the LessonCount on that group's own `group_heading_subdivided` line
expressible._restored_at_v15: kogaki#739. This entry sat in `not_expressible` from v13, under a reopen trigger it wrote for itself — "the first `cotag_groups` line class that carries a group's own member count again … at which point this entry moves back into `expressible` with its predicate restored". The trigger has FIRED: `group_heading_subdivided` carries `<LessonCount>` again on the owner ruling of 2026-09-01. The entry moves rather than being re-pointed, which is the same discipline the withdrawal obeyed — a rule aimed at a quantity the text no longer carries is a predicate that cannot fail, and re-pointing it at the sum of the SubGroup counts would have compared a quantity to itself.
expressible._the_pre_render_refusal_is_NOT_withdrawn: `cmdCotags` still refuses DOUBLE placement and UNDER-placement over the placement record, by name, before a display is composed (SPEC.md §6.2 rule 1). The two carriers read different things and neither subsumes the other: the pre-render refusal reads the DATA and catches a member placed twice or left unplaced; this rule reads the TEXT and catches a renderer that drops or miscounts a `subgroup_heading` line on data that placed correctly. That second failure is exactly what the withdrawn entry's `what_the_siting_costs` named as uncovered, and it is what returns to cover.
expressible._the_re_executable_case: NONE AT THIS HEAD (kogaki#770). It was checks/check-terrain-composition.sh — a crafted `validateSurface` case whose SubGroup counts do not reach the parent's, asserted to fire under this rule id, plus the emitter-side control that a conformant subdivided display still renders — and that member was REMOVED under the 2026-09-02 retention rule (0 catches over 120 exercised runs, 20.5 s local). The rule id is therefore in exactly the state this field's own last sentence names: restored to this category with nothing exercising it, the finding PR #757 round 1 made, one polarity over. Recorded as a stated absence rather than left pointing at a deleted file, because a present-tense existence claim about an exercised case is not a prose mention and the issue's leave-history-as-written clause does not reach it. Re-earning the case is a new registered member with its own admission economics.
expressible._removal_signal: the parent count leaving `group_heading_subdivided` again — the same event, read the other way, that put this entry in `not_expressible` at v13. Event-shaped and mechanically decidable from this file alone: no line class carrying a group's own member count means no side of the comparison, and the entry returns to `not_expressible` with its cost restated rather than being re-pointed.

expressible.rule: a `group_heading_flat` line whose LessonCount is >= 10 must be followed by at least one `subgroup_heading` line before the next group heading

not_expressible.rule: a SubGroup labelled `tight`, `related` or `loose` carries at most limits.subgroup_member_cap.<label> members, and at least limits.min_subgroup_members unless its members are the whole parent group; the residual `other` carries at most limits.max_residual_members and has no floor
not_expressible.why_not_expressible: The rendered text does not carry the two sides together. A `subgroup_heading` line carries the member count; the coherence label is on the SEPARATE `subgroup_coherence` line, so no single line class holds both, and the residual's total spans every `other` SubGroup in the group rather than sitting on one line at all. A rule keyed on `a subgroup_heading line whose coherence label is …` describes a line the grammar cannot produce.
not_expressible.carried_instead: Three refusals in the runtime, at J2_subdivision — over the label's cap, under M, and a residual over N — each naming the SubGroup and the limit it crossed (SPEC.md §8, kogaki#738 ruling 3 and owner amendments 1 and 2, 2026-09-01). They read `limits.subgroup_member_cap`, `limits.min_subgroup_members` and `limits.max_residual_members` directly.
not_expressible.what_the_siting_costs: The refusals read the DATA and never the TEXT, so a renderer that emits a conformant record's SubGroup with a wrong count on its own `subgroup_heading` line is invisible to them. What bounds that is now NARROWER THAN IT READS, and the narrowing is stated rather than left: `subgroup_members_sum_to_parent` left this section at v15 (kogaki#739) and constrains the SubGroup counts only in AGGREGATE — it catches a wrong count that moves the sum, and admits two wrong counts that cancel. The golden specimen bounds the rest, and at v15 it is still a display with no subdivided group in it, so for THIS entry the specimen bounds the per-SubGroup count not at all. Stated here because the sibling entry's restoration reads, from outside, like coverage this entry gained.
not_expressible.reopen_trigger: the first `cotag_groups` line class that carries a SubGroup's member count and its coherence label TOGETHER — at which point the per-label cap becomes decidable over the text and this entry moves into `expressible` with a predicate and a crafted case
not_expressible._sited_here_deliberately: It was in `expressible` at PR #757 (kogaki#738), where `validateSurface` dispatches on `rule.id` and an id with no arm is silently skipped — so the rule was considered and dropped on every display, which is the conformance-category-with-no-members shape this section's own header warns about. Moved rather than given an arm, because the predicate is not writable over the current line forms.

deferred_slot_full_report_allowlist.what_is_owed: A decision on whether full_report's three bare-placeholder body classes (`group_claim_body`, `subgroup_claim_body`, `member_gloss_body`) are constrained, so that `line_class_allowlist` becomes live on this surface -- or whether a SECTIONED allowlist is admitted instead, refusing only lines under a heading whose section declares a closed class set. The second shape would make the rule live for the neighborhood section without touching the claim bodies at all.
